description: LLM HTML-to-Markdown Cleaner API: Convert noisy web pages or raw HTML into clean, token-efficient Markdown for RAG. (Endpoint: POST /v1/html-to-markdown)

base_url.description: Optional base URL for resolving relative links when passing raw html.

cache.description: Allow edge KV caching for public URL fetches (defaults to true only for clean URLs without query strings or userinfo).

html.description: Raw HTML string to convert directly without fetching.

include_hidden.description: Include hidden DOM nodes (hidden, aria-hidden='true', display:none, font-size:0) (default false).

url.description: Public URL to fetch via private fetcher and convert to Markdown.

name: tinplate_html_to_markdown
